name: Next.js UI Quality
description: Rules for Next.js App Router and Pages Router projects with clear rendering boundaries and production metadata.

rules.instruction: Keep browser-only interaction and APIs inside client components; keep data fetching and stable content on the server where appropriate.
Provide loading, error, not-found, and empty states for routes and async UI instead of rendering blank shells.
Define meaningful page metadata, document titles, and social-preview content for the interface being shipped.
